protocol.split: leave-one-episode-out; all takes kept together; one episode per show, so this is also show-held-out
protocol.pod_definition: maximal contiguous commercial or promotional pod, including house promos; editorial excluded
protocol.stt_input: existing Whisper-small-quality timestamped transcript; inference assumes equivalent on-device STT output
protocol.audio_refinement: optional quiet-window boundary snap after transcript-only pod proposal
protocol.label_caveat: same-ASR pseudo-gold generated from transcript/corpus evidence; not independent human acceptance labels
